name: Iterative Reconstruction with Local Support Basis Functions
aliases: Algebraic Reconstruction with Visual Hull and Local Basis
definition: A tomographic method for reconstructing a volumetric model of fire from multiple images, using an algebraic reconstruction technique to restrict the solution space via a visual hull, allowing high-quality models from a small number of camera images.
summary: Iterative Reconstruction with Local Support Basis Functions reconstructs volumetric density from sparse views by using local basis functions and a visual hull to create a sparse system matrix, differing from Fourier-space methods.
